objects.taxonomy_description: Cylindrical stick of wax (15-30 cm tall, 2-5 cm diameter) with a central wick (cotton string) extending from the top. The wax body is smooth and uniform, available in white, ivory, or colored varieties. The surface has a matte or slightly glossy finish depending on wax type (paraffin, beeswax, soy). The top has a charred wick tip if previously burned. Taper candles narrow toward the top; pillar candles maintain uniform diameter. The base is flat for standing. Scented candles may have a slightly textured surface from fragrance oils. The overall shape is a simple vertical cylinder with a thin wick protruding from the center.

objects.taxonomy_description: Two-wheeled vehicle with a step-through frame, small wheels (10-16 inches), and a low-powered gasoline engine. Features a flat floorboard for the rider's feet, a padded seat, and handlebars with hand grips and controls. Body panels enclose the engine and mechanical components, painted in bright colors or pastels with a glossy finish. Front has a small windscreen or leg shield. Rear wheel is driven by a belt or chain enclosed in a swingarm. Overall length approximately 1.7-2 meters with a low seat height of 70-80 cm.

objects.taxonomy_description: Uncastrated adult male sheep measuring 65-110 cm at withers weighing 35-180 kg. Body covered with dense woolly fleece in white, brown, or black. Head broad with laterally spiraling horns (in horned breeds). Horns thick and ridged. Eyes dark with horizontal rectangular pupils. Ears lateral and drooping. Neck thick and muscular. Body compact and stocky. Legs sturdy with cloven hooves. Tail short. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, wool insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Secondary sexual characteristics include larger size and prominent horns.

Head_and_Face: Broad head with laterally spiraling horns (in horned breeds).
